data.one_liner: Read desktop screen size, work area, scale factor and cursor position on Windows, macOS and Linux.
data.what_it_does: Provides a synchronous API to query primary and all displays, their geometry, scale, orientation and other properties. It also streams display add/remove/change events and cursor location.
use_when: You need to adapt UI layout to multiple monitors or high‑DPI screens
You need to know the cursor position for custom pointer handling
You want to react to display configuration changes at runtime
avoid_when: You need a cross‑platform solution that also works on web
strengths: Works on all three desktop platforms with a single API
No native code required in your app – uses nativeapi under the hood
Synchronous calls make it easy to use in init code
weaknesses: Only supports desktop, no mobile or web
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, ensure GTK3/X11/Xi dev packages on Linux; requires Flutter 3.50+
